movelist.name: Poison Jab
movelist.effect: Poison Jab Poisons the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Recover
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Venoshock
movelist.effect: If the target is Poisoned, Venoshock has a Damage Base of 13 (4d10+10 / 35) instead.

movelist.name: Toxic
movelist.effect: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Wide Guard
movelist.effect: If an Ally adjacent to Wide Guard’s user is hit by a Move, you may use Wide Guard as an Interrupt. All targets adjacent to Wide Guard’s user, including the user, are instead not hit by the triggering Move and do not suffer any of its effects.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Paralysis. Defensive.

abilities.name: Cruelty
abilities.trigger: The user hits a foe with a damaging attack
abilities.effect: After Damage is Resolved, the foe gains an Injury. The user is then informed of the total number of Injuries currently on the target, and may use that number to “purchase” the effects listed below. »» 1 Injury: The target loses 2 Hit Points. May be “pur- chased” multiple times. »» 1 Injury: The target is Slowed. »» 2 Injuries: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.effect: If the user hits a poisoned target with a damaging attack, it automatically becomes a Critical Hit.
